novelty_flags.label: thm:tree-reduction
novelty_flags.one_line: Its substantive kernel is the published tree 1/2/infinity classification, so retain it only as a cited boundary corollary rather than a novel root solve target.

soundness_flags.label: def:generic-fiber and def:real-retained-set / Z_e
soundness_flags.one_line: The localization and “saturation by the original acyclic parametrization” are not specified as a concrete kernel or multiplicative set, leaving A_K and Z_e non-unique inputs to the degree and certificate claims.

soundness_flags.label: prop:attaining-family-membership

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:regular-finite-set-inference
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Inference is conditional on a fixed graph and a compact smooth covariance-model stratum with uniform pole, simple-root, root-separation, and real-lift-status margins.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The root-m and simultaneous-coverage claims are asserted only uniformly over the stated regular class K_G, not near discriminants or across branch-status boundaries.
